response.justification: Bogdan possesses extensive experience in geospatial data platforms and low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. While his recent technology stack leans heavily toward TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than the required modern C++ or Rust, his strong background in GIS, OS-level programming, and scalable architectures makes him a compelling candidate who could likely adapt quickly to the required toolchain.
strengths: Deep domain expertise in geospatial data processing, evidenced by founding GISCollective and working with Green Map.
Proven experience building low-latency, highly scalable distributed systems handling millions of requests per second.
Strong software craftsmanship background with a demonstrated ability to learn and adapt across the full technical stack.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, having primarily used DLang, TypeScript, and Node.js recently.
C and C++ experience is somewhat dated, with the most notable professional usage occurring between 2014 and 2015.
No explicit experience mentioned with routing algorithms, real-time traffic integration, or navigation guidance solutions.
